eventos.title: Simposio IEEE de Octubre: Encuentro Anual de Ingeniería, Ciencia y Tecnología
eventos.description:
En el marco de las celebraciones mundiales del IEEE Day, la Rama Estudiantil IEEE de la UNSA presenta el "Simposio IEEE de Octubre: Encuentro Anual de Ingeniería, Ciencia y Tecnología". 

Este simposio de dos días consecutivos reúne a los 7 capítulos técnicos y grupos de afinidad (Computer Society, ComSoc, MTT-S, PES, RAS, EMBS y WIE) en un formato dinámico, interactivo e intensivo. El evento está diseñado para evitar la monotonía mediante la combinación de ponencias especializadas de alto valor académico, estaciones de demostración práctica en vivo, trivias interactivas (Kahoot) con sorteos de merchandising oficial IEEE y paneles de discusión sobre el liderazgo en carreras STEM.

Ejes Temáticos del Simposio:
• CS (Computer Society): IA Generativa, Ciberseguridad en la Nube y Cloud Computing.
• ComSoc (Communications Society): Redes 5G/6G, Sistemas IoT e Infraestructura en Smart Cities.
• MTT-S (Microwave Theory and Technology): Diseño de Antenas y Componentes RF de Alta Frecuencia.
• PES (Power & Energy Society): Redes Eléctricas Inteligentes (Smart Grids) y Transición Energética.
• RAS (Robotics and Automation Society): Robótica Móvil, Drones y Automatización Industrial.
• EMBS (Engineering in Medicine and Biology): Procesamiento de Bioseñales e Ingeniería Médica.
• WIE (Women in Engineering): Panel sobre Liderazgo, Desafíos y Brecha de Género en STEM.

¡Acompáñanos a descubrir las fronteras de la tecnología, participar en dinámicas en vivo y ganar merchandising oficial del IEEE!

Se otorgará certificado de asistencia respaldado por la Rama Estudiantil IEEE a los participantes registrados.

eventos.title: WIE UNAJ Social Innovation Hackathon
eventos.description: The IEEE Women in Engineering Affinity Group of the Universidad Nacional de Juliaca (WIE UNAJ), in collaboration with the IEEE UNAJ Student Branch, will organize a one-day, in-person hackathon focused on developing innovative solutions to a social problem affecting the city of Juliaca. The event will bring together university students from different academic backgrounds who will be randomly assigned to multidisciplinary teams at the beginning of the activity. Each team will analyze the proposed local challenge, identify its main causes and needs, and develop a creative and feasible project to address it. Throughout the day, participants will work collaboratively through different stages, including problem analysis, ideation, solution development, prototyping, and final presentation. The activity will encourage students to apply their technical knowledge while strengthening teamwork, leadership, creativity, communication, and problem-solving skills. WIE UNAJ will promote an inclusive environment that encourages the active participation and leadership of women in STEM. Participants will receive guidance and support from organizers, mentors, and members of the IEEE community during the development of their projects. The event will be held entirely in person at the Universidad Nacional de Juliaca – Capilla, and lunch will be provided to participants as part of the full-day activity. At the end of the hackathon, each team will present its proposed solution to a jury, with projects evaluated according to criteria such as innovation, social impact, feasibility, and quality of the proposed solution.

eventos.title: YO INGENIERA - SEGUNDA EDICION
eventos.description:
Yo Ingeniera, es un taller vivencial dirigido a estudiantes mujeres de secundaria en colegios de provincia, con el objetivo de acercarlas al mundo de la ingeniería a través de testimonios reales de ingenieras de distintas especialidades. Busca despertar vocaciones STEM en un contexto donde el acceso a este tipo de actividades es más limitado que en Lima.

Para lograr este impacto, las actividades se llevarán a cabo en instituciones educativas clave de Huamanga, incluyendo la Institución Educativa Emblemática "Nuestra Señora de Fátima", la Institución Educativa "Nuestra Señora de las Mercedes", el Colegio "María Auxiliadora", la Institución Educativa "Guamán Poma de Ayala" y el Colegio de Alto Rendimiento (COAR) Ayacucho.

eventos.title: GEITEC 2026 – VIII International Conference on Technology, Engineering and Innovation Management
eventos.description:
The VIII International Conference GEITEC 2026 is an academic and professional event focused on science, technology, engineering and innovation management. The 2026 edition will be held in Panama City, Panama, from November 12 to 14, 2026.

GEITEC 2026 aims to provide a space for the exchange of research results, applied experiences, methodological approaches and institutional initiatives related to technology management, innovation systems, technology transfer, strategic foresight, technological surveillance, sustainable design, circular economy, data science and artificial intelligence applied to innovation.

The conference is addressed to researchers, professors, graduate students, professionals, innovation managers, technology transfer officers, entrepreneurs, policymakers and representatives of public and private organizations interested in strengthening innovation capabilities in Latin America and Ibero-America.

The event will include paper presentations, keynote lectures, thematic sessions, academic networking activities and spaces for collaboration among universities, research centers, companies, public institutions and innovation ecosystems.

Official website: www.geitec2026.org
